description.value: Administers the allocation instrument and has asked its forty-one questions, in order, rather more than two thousand times. He is writing a paper about what the order does to the answers, which his institute has not yet seen. He is very good with people who do not want to be interviewed.

notes.value: The paper on question order has been in draft since 2304. He has asked twice whether it needs ethics clearance and has had two different answers.
